artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: New module: the Kimi K3 classify_one/classify_many pattern, reusing estate_report_runner.call_kimi_sub's Chat Completions JSON shape and resolution_kimi.py's injected-transport/exact-schema-key discipline. Sends ONLY name+ticker (build_prompt's only data inputs). A reply outside the 5-value asset_class vocabulary or malformed/unparseable is refused to null with a reason, never coerced. LOW_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD=0.80. MAX_TOKENS raised to 4000 after a live probe measured kimi-k3's hidden reasoning-token consumption starving a naive 300-token budget to zero content tokens (KIMI_LENGTH_STARVED) -- see row MDPF_SECCLASS-W8-S1.

18 tests, network stubbed throughout (send always caller-injected): prompt/payload carry only name+ticker; out-of-vocabulary and malformed replies refused to null; never coerced (capitalization drift 'Equity' refused, not lowered); low_confidence true at 0.79 / false at 0.80; classify_many preserves entry order under concurrency; timeout terminal (no retry), transient 5xx retries once; contract carries contract_version 0.3.0, classified_by values incl. model, classification_confidence and low_confidence fields with rule24_records.

contract_version 0.2.0 -> 0.3.0. classified_by.values gains 'model' (written by classify-residual-model.py, conditional on ticker absence, exactly like scheduled/constituents; a seed row always wins per the existing precedence text, now extended to name model). New fields classification_confidence (number 0..1, present only on a model row) and low_confidence (boolean, present only on a model row, true below 0.80), each with a rule24_record naming what a seed correction does NOT move (state_coherence) and a word-boundary token census (zero collisions outside this cell's own new files).

The runner: reads the residual (E8's R2_UNRESOLVED_REVIEW_20260930.json, proposed_class null), reads the live table's row count (Select=COUNT full scan) and its sub_asset_class vocabulary per asset_class (etf_classification_scheduled.TableVocabulary.from_live_table, the same live-read pattern SC-k-1 already established), reads the Kimi key from Secrets Manager 'astn/kimi/api-key' (the exact id estate-report-runner's ESTATE_KIMI_SECRET_ID resolves to, infra/aws/terraform/estate-report/instance.tf:133) -- never printed or written -- calls the model, and writes ONLY the census JSON. NO table write: no PutItem/UpdateItem import, no --write flag. --workers enables concurrent calls (each an independent HTTP request, no shared state); the real run used --workers 20.

The real run against the live table and the real Kimi K3 endpoint, all 357 residual entries, name+ticker only. table_rows_at_build 2309. classified 260 (asset_class non-null), flagged 130 (confidence<0.80 among classified; 216 total rows below 0.80 including null-class rows the model itself was unsure enough to refuse), keyed 41, cusip_only 8, name_only 308 (41+8+308=357), would_write 41 (per the census's own definition: a keyed ticker absent from the live table -- 26 of these 41 carry a resolved class, 15 are model refusals (7 KIMI_TIMEOUT, 8 self-declared no-signal), see the half), overwrites 0 (structural -- this runner never writes the table).

Never-widen half for the FUTURE model-path write of the 26 real candidate rows (fixed_income 13, equity 7, alternatives 4, commodities 2; 11 of 26 flagged low_confidence). Names every classified_by reader (label-legacy-classified-by.py's attribute_not_exists-guarded scan, the ETFClassifier find_by_* client at its measured zero call sites, seed-etf-classifications.py's unconditional-seed-wins precedence), the writers counted (the model path itself; scheduled/constituents/seed are unaffected structurally), both branches (a ticker with no row gains one; a ticker with a row is untouched), and holds the 15 keyed-but-null, 308 name-only and 8 CUSIP-only entries for the round-4 analysis, naming them as having no key in this order.
